title: Personal Checking: Closing an Account, the Early Closure Fee and Disbursement
content:
## Whose decision

Closing a Personal Checking account is for the owner alone to decide. The agent registers a closure request, awaiting the customer's confirmation, that states how the balance will be paid out; the account closes only once the owner confirms that request. Accounts that are active or dormant close this way; a charged-off account is closed administratively by the bank.

## States that bar closure

- The account can be closed only while its ledger balance is zero or higher; a negative balance has to be paid off.
- The account cannot be closed while any dispute on it stands in submitted or provisionally credited status; closure becomes possible once the dispute is resolved.

Both are read from the bank's records for that account.

## Early closure fee

A closure dated inside the tier's early closure window costs the tier's early closure charge, booked as an early closure fee entry ahead of the payout. The window is counted in calendar days from the opening date: day 1 is the day after opening, and the fee applies when the closure date is no later than the opening date plus the window, the last day included. The fee is trimmed so that it never pushes the ledger below zero, and a tier whose fee is 0.00 books nothing.

## Interest and payout

On an interest-bearing tier, interest earned up to the day before closure is credited ahead of the payout. What is left on the ledger is then paid out in full, either by internal transfer to the PCB account named in the request or by an official check mailed to the address on file, with no official check fee. The account then closes at a zero balance and without any overdraft protection link.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical window of 60 days)

| Opened | Closure date | Early closure fee? |
|---|---|---|
| 5 January 2026 | 6 March 2026 (day 60) | yes |
| 5 January 2026 | 7 March 2026 (day 61) | no |

## Points of judgement

- A hypothetical account holding 10.00 USD, closed inside the window on a tier whose fee is larger, has the fee trimmed to 10.00 USD and pays out nothing.
- A tier conversion does not restart the early closure window; the opening date still governs.
